catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits one continuous geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint publication. cap.motion.cartesian_twist.v1 requires duration_s and returns applied and stopped_position with resource kind robot.arm; cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires duration_s and returns distance_m, heading_rad and stopped, while the pinned cmd_vel callback consumes a continuous Twist and has no completion, motion or stop acknowledgement. The binding sets linear.x, linear.y and angular.z; a rosbridge publication receipt is transmission evidence only.

No catalogue class carries a passive sensor_msgs/LaserScan observation. cap.sensing.point_cloud.v1 is a PointCloud2 capture action with an artifact_ref output, not a 2D range scan; no lidar class exists in the catalogue. The package uses an extension read capability with an inline LaserScan output schema.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 1 RosDriver for the pinned taucrates Go1 simulation. No Python native class and no native.py; the upstream packages are C++/launch/URDF. Primary control is x-cap.taucrates.cmd_vel.v1, one geometry_msgs/Twist publication on the relative cmd_vel endpoint named by go1_simulation/launch/velocity_smoother.launch:5-7 and remapped by go1_simulation/launch/navigate.launch:18. The observation is x-cap.taucrates.scan.v1, one sensor_msgs/LaserScan subscription on the scan endpoint named by go1_simulation/launch/navigate.launch:14 and used by the move_base costmaps at go1_config/config/move_base/costmap_common_params.yaml:14. The device is mode simulated, kind robot.mobile_base, risk R2 (a commanded mobile base is at least R2; the card floor is R0), with an empty resource snapshot. The 16 facts cite the README, the launch files, the Hokuyo and gazebo xacros, the ros_control configuration and the CHAMP gait files at c23ba0e6816337aeaa65e308140e0f201cf9167a.

WHY G7 REJECTS THE BINDINGS AND WHY THIS IS NOT WORKED AROUND: the pinned tree has 75 files and contains no .msg, .srv or .action file and no line that spells a fully qualified ROS message type. The launch files name relative topics (cmd_vel, scan) and the xacro files name Gazebo plugin parameters (topicName scan, trunk_imu, camera topics); the costmap YAML uses only the short names LaserScan and PointCloud2. The only ROS package name in the tree is the std_msgs catkin dependency (go1_simulation/package.xml:54-60, go1_description/package.xml:12), which names no message. The declared geometry_msgs/Twist and sensor_msgs/LaserScan types are the ROS convention for these topics, not upstream declarations, so no source_ref/type_ref can show them and G7 reports ROS_TYPE_NOT_UPSTREAM. I did not cite an unrelated string such as the costmap_2d::ObstacleLayer plugin class as a message type to obtain a green check, and I did not add a fake-only type. The pinned-source evidence is genuinely absent.

WHY G6 FAILS AND WHY NO STOP IS DECLARED: the pinned tree creates no ROS service server or action server. The only stop-like control is the launch-time paused argument at go1_simulation/launch/gazebo.launch:6,21, forwarded to the external gazebo_ros empty_world.launch; it is not a runtime endpoint. A zero-Twist publication is transmission only and is not an acknowledged stop. The driver therefore declares safety_bindings = {} and no safe_state=True action; the stock e-stop reports MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, the latch stays engaged, and G8 SAFE-028 follows from the same missing stop. This is a genuine upstream stop gap, not a missing fake feature.

G8 TCAP-003: the publication receipt is the helper's fixed {published: true, confirmed: false}; two distinct velocity inputs therefore return identical output and the empty resource snapshot does not change. The pinned tree declares no readable state topic with a citable type, and the fake does not invent an odometry read or a fake-only state field to manufacture an observable effect. This is a consequence of the same unacknowledged publication interface, not a reason to weaken the check.

LIMITS: the CHAMP gait configuration gives max_linear_vel_x 0.5, max_linear_vel_y 0.25 and max_angular_vel_z 1.0 (go1_config/config.json:197-202; repeated as macros in go1_config/include/gait_config.h:7-9). Those are gait parameters of the external controller, not a signed cmd_vel acceptance envelope, and no negative bound is stated. All three inputs use Limit.operator_required; site-limits.example.json contains illustrative values only, marked EXAMPLE ONLY, and may only narrow. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

FIDELITY AND NOT COVERED: the fake is a ROS-free analytic rosbridge contract stand-in, not a recording of captured traffic. It runs at F0 with timestep_ms 0 and realtime_factor 0: no Gazebo physics, gazebo_ros plugins, CHAMP gait, ray casting, depth camera, state estimator or wall-clock loop. Its scan is three placeholder ranges while the pinned ray sensor is configured for 800 samples over -3.1415926535897 to 3.1415926535897 rad at 20 Hz; the cmd_vel values are echoed only as placeholder contract state. NOT COVERED: the depth camera images and point clouds, IMU, odometry, TF, the twelve joint controllers, contact sensors, move_base, AMCL, gmapping, map_server, and Gazebo world stepping/reset. A live run requires the operator's ROS Noetic workspace, the external champ, yocs_velocity_smoother, gazebo_ros, realsense and scan-matcher packages, Gazebo and rosbridge; none was installed, started or validated here.
